text: You're looking for a vegetarian option that's high in fiber and can be prepared within your 45-minute time frame. This Simple and Delicious Low Fat Vegetarian Chili recipe fits the bill perfectly. With black beans as a main ingredient, you'll get a good dose of fiber to help you reach your health goal. The recipe also includes a variety of vegetables like onion, carrot, and red pepper, which will add to the fiber content. Plus, it's ready in just 35 minutes, making it a convenient option for you.
